     6	from __future__ import annotations

    10	REGISTRY: dict[str, callable] = {}
    11	
    12	
    13	def op(fn):
    14	    REGISTRY[fn.__name__] = fn
    15	    return fn
    16	
    17	
    18	@op
    19	def scale(w: np.ndarray, factor: float) -> np.ndarray:
    20	    return (w * factor).astype(w.dtype)
    21	
    22	
    23	@op
    24	def add(w: np.ndarray, delta: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    25	    if delta.shape != w.shape:

    40	    out[:, np.asarray(index)] = values
    41	    return out

    44	@op
    45	def interpolate(w: np.ndarray, other: np.ndarray, alpha: float) -> np.ndarray:
    46	    """(1-alpha)*w + alpha*other. alpha=1 is a transplant, alpha>1 extrapolates."""
    47	    if other.shape != w.shape:
    48	        raise ValueError(f"other {other.shape} does not match {w.shape}")
    49	    return ((1.0 - alpha) * w + alpha * other).astype(w.dtype)
    50	
    51

    53	def transplant(w: np.ndarray, donor: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    54	    if donor.shape != w.shape:
    55	        raise ValueError(f"donor {donor.shape} does not match {w.shape}")

    60	def project_out(w: np.ndarray, direction: np.ndarray, axis: int = 0,
    61	                index: list[int] | None = None) -> np.ndarray:
    62	    """Remove the component along a unit ``direction`` from selected rows/columns.
    63	
    64	    ``axis=0``: each selected row ``w[i, :]`` loses its projection onto the
    65	    direction (direction has length ``w.shape[1]``). ``axis=1``: each selected
    66	    column ``w[:, j]`` does (direction has length ``w.shape[0]``). This is the
    67	    Exp-8 edit of the post — subtract one direction from N output columns.
    68	    """

    82	            raise ValueError("direction length must equal the number of rows")

    97	    layer's padding is set to 0 in the VGSL spec (``Cr1,1,85,1,1``).
